[EN] Rhodos and pursued Dakuryon into the tunnels beneath Trellum Consurgo. The Seekers of Highwatch broke down the archdevan seal to give them a fighting chance against Dakuryon's magic.
[ES] Rhodos y persiguieron a Dakuryon hacia los túneles bajo Trellum Consurgo. Los Seekers of Highwatch rompieron el sello archideva para darles una oportunidad de luchar contra la magia de Dakuryon.

[EN] Hurry! Dakuryon mustn't escape!"Where did he go?"
[ES] ¡Date prisa! ¡Dakuryon no debe escapar!"Where did he go?"

[EN] I saw him flee to the lower levels.

Quickly now!
[ES] Lo vi huir hacia los niveles inferiores.

¡Rápido ahora!

[EN] Come! There's no time to waste!
[ES] ¡Ven! ¡No hay tiempo que perder!

[EN] Like the rat he is, Dakuryon scurries into a tunnel. How fitting!
[ES] Como la rata que es, Dakuryon se escabulle en un túnel. ¡Qué apropiado!

[EN] We deconstructed the archdevan seal you captured. There's little time to test it, but it should help you in your fight against Dakuyron.

Please, save the High Elder.
[ES] Desarmamos el sello archideva que capturaste. Hay poco tiempo para probarlo, pero debería ayudarte en tu pelea contra Dakuryon.

Por favor, salva al High Elder.
